effects.text: Choose the projectiles next: a stack of arrows, bolts, sling bullets, darts or shuriken (any ammunition or thrown weapon, warped), up to 30. They are split off as their own stack, with their range increments doubled for the spell's duration. Target an ally to enchant theirs.

warps.text: affect projectiles of up to a large size

system.description:
AIR ALTERATION UTILITY

Tradition arcane, ethereal; Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal); Range touch; Target up to 30 projectiles no bigger than a normal arrow.; Duration 10 minutes

For the duration of this spell, the affected projectiles have their range increments doubled.

WARPING OPTIONS

+2 PP: increase the duration to 1 hour.

+4 PP: affect projectiles of up to a large size.

Automated: when the cast succeeds you choose a stack of arrows, bolts, sling bullets, darts or shuriken (B8-3; with the +4 PP warp, any ammunition or thrown weapon) and how many, up to 30. They are split off as their own stack, and its range increments are doubled until the spell's time is up.
